takeaways.headline: New models and agent tools arrive for testing while security holds tighten

items.title: Assessing new models for extraction and productivity
items.meaning: New language models offer lower pricing, faster speed, and benchmark gains. DPA can assess and trial these models to improve extraction accuracy, research depth, financial reporting pipelines, and developer velocity.
items.use: Run GPT-6.2 Astra and Claude Fable 5.2 on 30 complex private equity fund reports to compare extraction accuracy, latency, and token cost against current production models on public or synthetic files first.

items.title: Trialing tool retrieval and decision APIs for agents
items.meaning: New API features and benchmarks help manage large tool libraries, speed up bounded-choice document checks, and measure reliability in multi-step agentic workflows and automated data pipelines.
items.use: Integrate Tool Retrieval into an existing Gemini-based agent workflow with 50 plus tools and compare input token costs and latency against static loading using public test data.

items.title: Locking down dependencies and reviewing coding agent security
items.meaning: Compromised packages and auto-deploy coding agents pose credential theft and data leakage risks, requiring strict security reviews and dependency lockdowns in agentic workflow development.
items.use: Immediately audit and lock down all dependencies used in agentic workflow development, and enforce strict security reviews on any internal apps built with coding agents.
